about: Games in GAMES (public/assets/js/games.js) still without a game.json (#1249). A ratchet: public/assets/js/conformance.test.mjs fails on a new entry or a stale one. Migrate with node tools/generators/manifests.mjs migrate <folder>.

games.copa: Not a game folder with modes but a week-long tournament: its entry has fields the manifest schema lacks (durationUnit, formato, torneo), so manifests.mjs migrate refuses it.
